entry.title: Cohere is another known group known in making huge efforts with many people, seems like this is their latest
entry.content:
Cohere is another known group known in making huge efforts with many people, seems like this is their latest:
I cannot be translated.
I cannot be web-searched.
I only make sense if you grew up where I did.
What am I?

A good riddle.

We're building a multicultural benchmark of culturally grounded riddles from communities around the world. We're not looking for translators: we're looking for locals. Come stump the machines and ensure your culture is represented in the next chapter.

Join our server to get involved: https://discord.gg/RhNX2STPj

Shared in Discord
